description.zh:
混合云集群 ID。
> 只针对混合云场景，您可以调用[DescribeHybridCloudClusters](~~2849376~~)获取混合云集群信息。
description.en:
The ID of the hybrid cloud cluster.
> This parameter applies only to hybrid cloud scenarios. You can call the [DescribeHybridCloudClusters](~~2849376~~) operation to query hybrid cloud cluster information.

description.zh:
WAF实例ID。

> 您可以通过调用[DescribeInstance](~~433756~~)接口查看当前WAF实例ID。
description.en:
Instance ID of the WAF instance.

> You can call the [DescribeInstance](~~433756~~) operation to query instance ID of the WAF instance.

description.zh: 分页查询时每页个数。取值范围为：1-5，默认值为 5。
description.en: The number of entries per page in a paged query. Valid values: 1 to 5. Default value: 5. This parameter is used for paging.

description.zh:
WAF实例所属地域。取值：

- **cn-hangzhou**：表示中国内地。

- **ap-southeast-1**：表示非中国内地。
description.en:
The region where the WAF instance is deployed. Valid values:

- **cn-hangzhou**: the Chinese mainland.

- **ap-southeast-1**: outside the Chinese mainland.

description.zh: 请求敏感信息类型列表。
description.en: The list of request sensitive information types.
